title: Conditional and Mapped Types
description: Learn how to use conditional and mapped types for advanced type transformations in React.

data.text: Conditional and mapped types let you transform existing types based on conditions. They are the foundation of many advanced TypeScript patterns used in React libraries.

data.title: infer Keyword
data.text: The infer keyword lets you extract types inside conditional types. It's used extensively by TypeScript's built-in utility types like ReturnType and Parameters.

data.title: Exercise: Create a DeepReadonly Type
data.description: Build a recursive type that makes all nested properties readonly.
steps: Start with a conditional type checking if T is an object
Use keyof to iterate over properties
Recursively apply DeepReadonly to nested objects
Exclude arrays and functions from recursion
Test with a deeply nested interface
